span.p: 1. PostgreSQL PITR\nRestore from snapshot or replica\nVerify row counts + FK constraints

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. Redis Cache Warming
Pre-warm policy cache (top 100 tenants)
Pre-warm tenant config cache
Target: > 80% hit rate in 15 min

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. OPA Policy Restore
Pull from Git remote
Build + sign bundle (SHA-256)
Upload to distribution bucket
Force sidecar poll

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. Kubernetes State (Velero)
Restore latest successful backup
Verify all pods running
PVCs bound, ConfigMaps present

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. Temporal Recovery
Restore underlying DB (step 1)
Verify server health
Resume stuck workflows from checkpoint
Restart workers

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6. Secret Rotation
All secrets considered compromised
Rotation order:
 a. Database passwords
 b. External API keys
 c. Internal service tokens
 d. Customer-facing keys (notify)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7. DNS Cutover
TTL pre-lowered to 30s
UPSERT CNAME → DR LB
Verify propagation (< 60s)
Restore TTL to 300s when stable

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
